signature.name: VTask.IsOrthogonal
signature.type: {R : Type u_20} -> {M : Type u_21} -> [CommRing R] -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> (B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M) -> (f : M → M) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: IsOrthogonal is a universally quantified Prop defined for all B and f without any domain restriction or junk-value convention; it is simply true or false for each pair (B, f).

facts.statement: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M) (f g : M → M), VTask.IsOrthogonal B f → VTask.IsOrthogonal B g → VTask.IsOrthogonal B (f ∘ g)

facts.statement: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M) (f : M ≃ M), LinearMap.IsAdjointPair B B f f.symm ↔ VTask.IsOrthogonal B f

facts.statement: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M), IsLeftRegular (2 : R) → B.IsSymm → (∀ x : M, B (f x) (f x) = B x x) → VTask.IsOrthogonal B f
